answer: For fiscal year 2022, PepsiCo reported net revenue of $86,392 million, operating profit of $11,512 million, and depreciation and amortization of $2,763 million from the statement of cash flows. Unadjusted EBITDA is calculated as operating profit plus depreciation and amortization ($11,512 million + $2,763 million = $14,275 million). The resulting unadjusted EBITDA % margin is 16.52% ($14,275 million / $86,392 million).
rationale: All numbers (Net Revenue, Operating Profit, and Depreciation and Amortization) are retrieved directly from the PepsiCo FY2022 10-K financial statements. EBITDA is correctly computed as Operating Profit plus Depreciation and Amortization, and the EBITDA margin is computed by dividing EBITDA by Net Revenue.
